operation: §183 — bounded inactive settlement behavior validation: STOPPED BEFORE SPEND

SPEND.note: the authorization instructs STOP before spend if the cohort cannot be made valid without materially changing the instrument. It cannot. Nothing was spent.

WHY_STOPPED.summary: the §182 settlement path requires owed facts, and the owed-fact content required to construct them does not exist in the frozen instrument. Constructing it means authoring the discrimination that §183's primary target exists to test.

blockers.finding: the frozen §174 truth carries MATERIAL_UNRESOLVED_FACTS = null on 10 of 10 rows, with every narrative field null and annotated 'not supplied by the product owner; not inferred'
blockers.consequence: there is no product-owner statement of what fact any row owes. The rows are authoritative for WHETHER a clarification is required, not for WHAT fact is owed.
blockers.precedent: §175 hit the same wall and recorded it verbatim; it has since blocked strict scoring at §177, §179 and now §183

blockers.finding: the only per-row owed-fact content that exists is §173's PAIR-MAP, headed AUTHORING-SIDE ONLY with intendedRoleIsNotTruth, and it lacks whyUnresolved, both branches and the decision divergence that a valid OwedFact requires
blockers.consequence: the four narrative fields that make an owed fact an owed fact must be written by someone

blockers.finding: DECISIVE — for HR-04 any wording specific enough to be a genuine owed fact states the presence/securement distinction outright, which is the exact discrimination the experiment tests whether the model can make
blockers.consequence: a pass would measure the stimulus this model wrote, not the architecture. The alternative — deriving the framing from app-mg-01 — yields guarding_status, which cannot express the property at all.
blockers.rootCause: §181's GOVERNED_FUNCTIONAL_TEST_METHOD_PRESENT = FALSE, arriving at construction time rather than at review time
blockers.precedent: §167 already measured this confound and recorded that it could not attribute its result, because the manipulation included 'a substantially richer statement of the owed fact'

blockers.finding: human-authoritative owed-fact targets exist for exactly two rows — HS-A1 and HS-E1 — both REQUIRED-shaped, from §162 and reviewed at §169
blockers.consequence: a defensible cohort exists but cannot test containment or settled positive controls, because there are zero human-authoritative rows carrying a SETTLED owed fact

WHAT_WAS_NOT_DONE.whyNot: a preregistration is a pre-spend freeze of a run that is going to happen. Writing one for a run that will not happen would misrepresent the record.
WHAT_WAS_NOT_DONE.reviewPacket: none — there are no claims to review
WHAT_WAS_NOT_DONE.humanVerdicts: none, and none were to be supplied by this model in any case

INTEGRITY_AT_STOP.method: hashes recomputed from the actual files at the moment of stopping

SECTION_182_STATE_UNCHANGED.note: §183 measured nothing and therefore neither confirms nor disturbs any §182 finding. The structural proofs stand as implementation evidence exactly as recorded.

CLAIM_BOUNDARY.established: nothing about behaviour. No provider ran.
mustNotClaim: that the settlement architecture behaves correctly
that challenge reasons are or are not reviewable
that HR-04, HR-05 or HR-07 behave differently under the structured path
production readiness, customer readiness, formal acceptance
CLAIM_BOUNDARY.whatIsEstablished: one thing, and it is a fact about the instrument rather than the system: the frozen ten-row instrument cannot supply owed facts, and constructing them for HR-04 requires authoring the discrimination under test
